supersedes: SED-E2-HEADROOM decision rule in RESEARCH_PACKET v1 (retracted: it inferred a <5 pp improvement bound from a <10% ambiguity fraction, and it counted ambiguity rather than success differences)
unit: original user task; attack variants nested and averaged within the task
bound: H = mean_t[s_oracle(t) - s_rule(t)], same plan, contract and read-time candidate set; UNRESOLVED kept in the denominator (H_upper counts their largest possible gap)
decision_rule: hold learning investment under this fixed contract only if H_upper < delta; H_upper >= delta is not evidence for learning
rule: unique-or-abstain over contract-admitted candidates (for the simulator: selectors.RuleField)
contract_derivation_real_benchmarks: for each state-changing argument, the (read tool, field path) where its BENIGN ground-truth value appears; fixed once per task and reused for every variant
success_criterion_real_benchmarks: benchmark-provided post-state utility() and not security(); never our extraction or string labels

sim.label: ENGINEERING_ONLY smoke test; success is generator gold, not independent
sim.episodes: SED-E1 instance-split test episodes regenerated from configs/first_run.json
